title: You Have 2 Minutes After A Box Jellyfish Sting

scenes.notes: You missed it because it's nearly clear: a bell up to dinner-plate size, trailing up to sixty tentacles, the longest taller than your ceiling.

scenes.notes: That's a box jellyfish, called the sea's most venomous animal, and it's stuck to your shin.

scenes.notes: Its tentacles are lined with nematocysts, coiled harpoons on hair triggers, and your skin just pulled thousands.
How fast? In a cousin, five million g, fifty times a rifle bullet, so the venom's in before you feel it.

props.text: CAN DROP ADULTS IN SHALLOW WATER

scenes.notes: Ninety seconds left, and the pain alone can drop you in the shallows.
And the venom punches holes in your cells, flooding your blood with potassium, straight to your heart.

scenes.notes: Eighty seconds. Good news, you've got options. Rub it? Every rub pulls more triggers, so you're petting a loaded gun. Rinse it? Fresh water fires any still loaded on you, and pee is fresh water with extra steps. Tough it out? That potassium's heading for your heart, and hearts can't tough anything out. Vinegar, thirty seconds. The harpoons still loaded on you, switched off.

scenes.notes: One minute left. Catch is, you're down in the shallows, so someone else pulls you out, calls for help, CPR if needed, then pours.
That's why Queensland beaches keep vinegar on posts.

scenes.notes: The strange part? Twenty-four eyes, none on you. It was fishing for shrimp, and you swam into the net.
